prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite master for Stone & Shadow. Input reference is the APPROVED mayor identity, wardrobe, material rendering and proportions; preserve them exactly. This is a new animation sheet, NOT a turnaround or bust sheet.
Exactly 4 full-body figures of the SAME character all exactly front-facing, looking toward viewer. Layout an exact 2 by 2 grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Same body scale in every cell; complete head/crown/helmet and boots, generous empty gutters and padding on all edges, consistent local ground baseline and torso center. No labels or dividers. Four successive speaking mouth poses, closed/parted/open/parted, small natural head and hand gestures with feet planted. Irritable pompous complaint; a few tiny pale saliva flecks just outside mouth in frames 2 and 3, short comic spray not drool, no puddles.
Identity constraints: Very obese middle-aged human mayor, bald with gray side hair, tiny crown, burgundy/purple gold-embroidered robes, round naturally angry face. Preserve robe hem and boots. Retain approved restrained facial anatomy, not grotesque. Match detailed painted game illustration with warm upper-left light, crisp contours and textured materials. Do not add weapons, props or change outfit. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, shadows, scenery, checkerboard, text, watermark or extra figures.
